item.title: Federal Reserve rate decision: raised by 0.25 point, to a 3.75-4.00% target range (effective 2026-09-17)
item.description: The FOMC raised its target range for the federal funds rate by 0.25 percentage point, to 3.75% to 4.00%, effective 2026-09-17. From FRED (DFEDTARL, DFEDTARU).
